iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

RADIUS::id
       RADIUS::id

SYNOPSIS
       RADIUS::id

DESCRIPTION
       This command returns the RADIUS message id

RETURN VALUE
       This command returns the RADIUS message id

VALID DURING
       CLIENT_ACCEPTED CLIENT_CLOSED CLIENT_DATA SERVER_CLOSED SERVER_CONNECTED SERVER_DATA

EXAMPLES
	when CLIENT_ACCEPTED {
	    let msg_id [RADIUS::id]
	    log local0. "recieved radius message with id $msg_id"
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-10.1.0
	   --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
